primary.title: Notes on the State of Virginia
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: Jefferson's most famous and comprehensive work, detailing the geography, history, and society of Virginia. It is a foundational text for understanding his thought.

primary.title: The Declaration of Independence
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: The foundational document of American independence, primarily authored by Jefferson. Its historical significance is immense.

primary.title: The Papers of Thomas Jefferson
primary.author: Thomas Jefferson
primary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of Jefferson's writings, including letters, drafts, and official documents, spanning his entire life. Essential for in-depth research.

secondary.title: Thomas Jefferson: The Art of Power
secondary.author: Jon Meacham
secondary.rationale: A highly acclaimed and comprehensive biography that explores Jefferson's political strategies and intellectual life.

secondary.title: American Sphinx: The Character of Thomas Jefferson
secondary.author: Joseph J. Ellis
secondary.rationale: A Pulitzer Prize-winning biography that delves into the complexities and contradictions of Jefferson's character and legacy.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Thomas Jefferson
secondary.author: Mark J. Rozell
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Jefferson's life, thought, and impact.

suggestions.notes: The 'Papers of Thomas Jefferson' are extensive and often published in multi-volume sets. Availability on Internet Archive is highly probable for digitized versions.
